text: ミックスオレを　もうひとつ　おそなえして　あげますか？
note: おそなえ is the Japanese custom of leaving offerings at a grave, often food or drink the dead liked in life. That is why the drink here turns out to be the Onix's favourite.
claim: In Japan it is customary to leave food or drink that the deceased liked as an offering (osonae) at their grave.

check.quote: そして故人の好物だった菓子・果物などをお供えし、ろうそくとお線香を手向けます。
